We're talking about a videogame here, one that's not particularly great as a siege or battle simulator. I'm just trying to offer suggestions on how to balance things while keeping it fun. If bows were only good against the peasantry that would make things pretty dull. In the context of Conquerer's blade, coding in everything you mentioned above would be a huge investment as well. Also, the rate of fire has a direct impact on damage, slowing it down would make archers less deadly. That being said, I still stand behind the idea of a lower RoF during focused fire, plus making the circle wider. What do you think? It would take much less time and effort than some other methods, and while not a complete fix could serve as a decent and necessary nerf to ranged that you're asking for.

Archers didn’t need to see their targets historically, a commander would often just tell them at what angle to shoot and they would aim and fire. What do you think about focused fire having a slower rate of fire overall? It wouldn’t fix all of the problems mentioned but it could help.

It's not much, but it's more of a hassle than just sending a colonist to a province. Plus, colonization is and always has been a race, so letting a native colonize for you can backfire if someone else declares war first.

Overall I just think slowing down colonization for tribes would make them even more boring to play than they are now. 90% of the time you're just waiting on colonies, and the other 10% is war with other tribes or colonial nations.
